```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(readxl)
library(openair)
library(MatchIt)
library(geosphere)
library(janitor)
library(broom)
library(vars)
library(lmtest)
library(tseries)

# ==== 1) Parámetros/paths ====
PATH_SRC <- "C:/Users/albar/OneDrive/Escritorio/SIMA/cadereyta_SE3_2024.xlsx"
PATH_NE2 <- "C:/Users/albar/OneDrive/Escritorio/SIMA/apodaca_NE2_2024.xlsx"
PATH_SE2 <- "C:/Users/albar/OneDrive/Escritorio/SIMA/juarez_SE2_2024.xlsx"

# Coordenadas 
coords <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Estacion,        ~lat,       ~lon,
  "cadereyta_SE3",   25.60111,   -99.99917,
  "apodaca_NE2",     25.77722,   -100.18810,
  "juarez_SE2",      25.64583,   -100.09530
)

season_of <- function(d) {
  m <- lubridate::month(d)
  dplyr::case_when(
    m %in% c(12,1,2) ~ "winter",
    m %in% c(3,4,5)  ~ "spring",
    m %in% c(6,7,8)  ~ "summer",
    TRUE             ~ "autumn"
  )
}

read_station <- function(path, station_name){
  df <- readxl::read_excel(path, guess_max = 1e5) |>
    janitor::clean_names()

  if (!inherits(df$date, c("POSIXct","POSIXt","Date"))) {
    if (is.numeric(df$date)) {
      df <- df |> dplyr::mutate(date = as.POSIXct(date * 86400, origin = "1899-12-30", tz = "America/Monterrey"))
    } else {
      df <- df |>
        dplyr::mutate(date = suppressWarnings(lubridate::ymd_hms(date, tz = "America/Monterrey"))) |>
        dplyr::mutate(date = ifelse(is.na(date), lubridate::ymd(date, tz = "America/Monterrey"), date),
                      date = as.POSIXct(date, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "America/Monterrey"))
    }
  } else {
    df <- df |> dplyr::mutate(date = as.POSIXct(date, tz = "America/Monterrey"))
  }

  df <- df |> dplyr::mutate(estacion = station_name)

  if (!"season" %in% names(df)) {
    df <- df |> dplyr::mutate(season = season_of(date))
  }

  df |>
    dplyr::select(
      date, co, no, no2, nox, o3, pm10, pm2_5,
      prs, rainf, rh, sr, tout, wsr, wdr, wind_u, wind_v,
      so2, season, photo_index, estacion
    )
}

src <- read_station(PATH_SRC, "cadereyta_SE3")
ne2 <- read_station(PATH_NE2, "apodaca_NE2")
se2 <- read_station(PATH_SE2, "juarez_SE2")

# ==== 4) Utilidades viento/geometría ====
uv_to_wd <- function(u, v){
  (atan2(-u, -v) * 180/pi) %% 360
}

bearing_src_to <- function(src_lat, src_lon, rec_lat, rec_lon){
  as.numeric(geosphere::bearing(c(src_lon, src_lat), c(rec_lon, rec_lat))) %% 360
}

sector_hit <- function(wd, bearing, half_width = 20){
  ang_diff <- ((wd - bearing + 540) %% 360) - 180
  abs(ang_diff) <= half_width
}

b_ne2 <- with(coords, bearing_src_to(
  lat[Estacion=="cadereyta_SE3"], lon[Estacion=="cadereyta_SE3"],
  lat[Estacion=="apodaca_NE2"],  lon[Estacion=="apodaca_NE2"])
)
b_se2 <- with(coords, bearing_src_to(
  lat[Estacion=="cadereyta_SE3"], lon[Estacion=="cadereyta_SE3"],
  lat[Estacion=="juarez_SE2"],   lon[Estacion=="juarez_SE2"])
)

# ==== 5) Preparar pares fuente-receptora ====
prep_pair <- function(source_df, rec_df, bearing_to_rec, ws_min = 2, half_width = 20){
  df <- source_df |>
    dplyr::select(date, co, no, no2, nox, o3, pm10, pm2_5, so2) |>
    dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_src"), -date) |>
    dplyr::inner_join(rec_df, by = "date") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      wd = dplyr::if_else(is.na(wdr) & !is.na(wind_u) & !is.na(wind_v),
                          uv_to_wd(wind_u, wind_v), wdr),
      from_refinery = sector_hit(wd, bearing_to_rec, half_width) & wsr >= ws_min,
      hour = lubridate::hour(date),
      wday = lubridate::wday(date, label = TRUE)
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(date)
  df
}

pair_ne2 <- prep_pair(src, ne2, b_ne2)
pair_se2 <- prep_pair(src, se2, b_se2)

# ==== 6) Diagnósticos openair ====
diag_openair <- function(rec_df, station_label){
  odf <- rec_df |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      date,
      ws = wsr,
      wd = dplyr::if_else(is.na(wdr) & !is.na(wind_u) & !is.na(wind_v), uv_to_wd(wind_u, wind_v), wdr),
      NO2 = no2, O3 = o3, PM25 = pm2_5,
      season = season, Estacion = estacion
    )
  openair::windRose(odf, ws = "ws", wd = "wd", type = c("Estacion","season"))
  openair::pollutionRose(odf, pollutant = "NO2", ws = "ws", wd = "wd", type = c("Estacion","season"))
  for(pol in c("NO2","O3","PM25")){
    openair::polarPlot(odf, pollutant = pol, ws = "ws", wd = "wd", type = "season",
                       main = paste0("polarPlot - ", station_label, " - ", pol))
  }
}

diag_openair(ne2, "Apodaca NE2")
diag_openair(se2, "Juárez SE2")

# ==== 7) Emparejamiento / ATT por temporada  ====

# Calcula el ATT para un contaminante específico
run_matching <- function(df_pair, pollutant = "no2") {
  base <- df_pair |>
    mutate(
      hour = factor(lubridate::hour(date)),
      wday = factor(lubridate::wday(date, label = TRUE))
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(from_refinery, tout, rh, prs, sr, wsr, hour, wday, !!sym(pollutant)) |>
    tidyr::drop_na()

  # Verifica que haya datos de ambos grupos
  if (length(unique(base$from_refinery)) < 2L) {
    return(tibble(
      pollutant = pollutant,
      ATT = NA_real_, conf_low = NA_real_, conf_high = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_, n_treated = sum(base$from_refinery),
      n_control = sum(!base$from_refinery),
      note = "Sin variación en from_refinery"
    ))
  }

  # Emparejamiento básico con propensity score
  m <- tryCatch(
    MatchIt::matchit(
      from_refinery ~ tout + rh + prs + sr + wsr + hour + wday,
      data = base,
      method = "nearest", distance = "logit"
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(m)) {
    return(tibble(
      pollutant = pollutant,
      ATT = NA_real_, conf_low = NA_real_, conf_high = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_, n_treated = sum(base$from_refinery),
      n_control = sum(!base$from_refinery),
      note = "Error en MatchIt"
    ))
  }

  md <- MatchIt::match.data(m)
  tt <- t.test(as.formula(paste0(pollutant, " ~ from_refinery")), data = md)

  tibble(
    pollutant = pollutant,
    ATT = diff(rev(tt$estimate)),  # treated - control
    conf_low = tt$conf.int[1],
    conf_high = tt$conf.int[2],
    p_value = tt$p.value,
    n_treated = sum(md$from_refinery),
    n_control = sum(!md$from_refinery),
    note = "OK"
  )
}

# Ejecuta el ATT por temporada y por contaminante
att_by_season <- function(df_pair, label) {
  if (!"season" %in% names(df_pair)) {
    df_pair <- df_pair |> mutate(season = season_of(date))
  }

  pollutants <- c("no2", "so2", "pm2_5", "pm10", "o3")
  results <- list()

  for (pol in pollutants) {
    for (s in unique(df_pair$season)) {
      subset_df <- df_pair |> filter(season == s)
      res <- run_matching(subset_df, pollutant = pol)
      res$season <- s
      res$station_pair <- label
      results[[length(results) + 1]] <- res
    }
  }

  bind_rows(results)
}

# === Ejecuta el cálculo
ATT_NE2 <- att_by_season(pair_ne2, "Cadereyta->NE2")
ATT_SE2 <- att_by_season(pair_se2, "Cadereyta->SE2")

ATT <- bind_rows(ATT_NE2, ATT_SE2) |>
  arrange(station_pair, pollutant, season)

print(ATT)
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(ATT, aes(x = season, y = ATT, fill = pollutant)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge()) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf_low, ymax = conf_high),
                width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  facet_wrap(~ station_pair) +
  labs(title = "Efecto promedio (ATT) del viento desde la refinería",
       y = "Cambio en concentración (µg/m³)",
       x = "Temporada") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```
